name: The Ride Drawn in Chalk
prompt: Lay a broad slate floor crisscrossed by luminous chalk circles. Tiny wooden passenger cars follow the lines as children redraw junctions with enormous chalk sticks. A sweeper erases an abandoned loop beside a pile of coloured dust.

name: The Giant's Pocket
prompt: Turn an enormous mustard corduroy pocket inside out to make a fairground. A rolling thimble carries passengers, a comb becomes a climbing rack, and a red yo-yo rises on its string like a lift. Loose stitching frames the entrance.

name: A Coaster for Fallen Leaves
prompt: Wind an open copper trough in a loose descending corkscrew. Leaf-shaped passenger boats drift on a stream of air from huge leather bellows. The last leaf drops gently into a russet collecting basket.

name: The Park on a Hinge
prompt: Mount five carnival platforms along the edges of an enormous folding paper toy. As one platform rises, another becomes level for boarding. Keep the cream undersides and their red hinge straps exposed where attendants work the levers.

name: The Marble Holiday
prompt: Nest a giant pale-blue marble run among low green hills. Families ride inside hollow, slowly rolling transparent balls. One ball rests in a forked cradle while attendants choose its onward path with an enormous yellow pin.
